sloka: दृढ बद्ध कवाटानि महापरिघवन्ति च ।चत्वारि विपुलान्यस्या द्वाराणि सुमहान्ति ॥६-३-११॥।।
transliteration: dṛḍha baddha kavāṭāni mahāparighavanti ca ।catvāri vipulānyasyā dvārāṇi sumahānti ॥6-3-11॥।।

translations.english: "Lanka is endowed with lofty wide courtyards, entrances with doors that are fixed with metal fixtures and large iron bars."
